{{Top|notoc=1}}
[[File:FalconAsteroidChase-SWM.jpg|200px|thumb|The [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] being pursued by [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] in an asteroid field]]
{{Quote|That wasn't a laser blast! Something hit us!|Han Solo|<ref name="Episode 5">{{Film|V}}</ref>}}
An '''asteroid''' was a solid object orbiting a [[Star/Legends|star]] that was smaller than a [[Planet/Legends|planet]], ranging from dozens of meters to hundreds of kilometers in size. Asteroids were often found in an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] within a star system. [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] had a dogfight in an asteroid field near [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. The asteroids resulted in Kenobi fooling Jango into thinking he had destroyed the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] escaped from [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]] by flying into the [[Hoth asteroid field/Legends|Hoth asteroid field]].

Smaller versions of asteroids were meteoroids, which became meteors or meteor showers in [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheres]], and meteorites on impact with planets.

Clouds of asteroids sometimes appeared as a result of the crash of two planets, as in the outer cloud of [[Lamaro system]] known as [[The Reef]]. This cloud limited the access to the inner system through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] unless exact coordinates were provided,<ref name="BL">{{GamerCite|7|Bartyn's Landing (article)}}</ref> as traveling through the cloud while on hyperspace could cause an [[Hyperspace anomaly/Legends|anomaly]].<ref name="R">{{GamerCite|7|Reckonings}}</ref>

During the [[Thrawn campaign|Thrawn Crisis]], [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] used asteroids as a siege weapon, they were equipped with [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking devices]] and [[Siege of Coruscant|deployed]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], effectively putting the capital of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] out of war.<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>

Asteroids could be used as military bases of operations; such was the case with the [[Chiss Expansionary Fleet/Legends|Chiss Expansionary Fleet]] [[Crustai asteroid base|base]] in the [[Crustai system/Legends|Crustai system]].<ref name="OF">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], at least one potato was used to portray the asteroids of the [[Hoth asteroid field/Legends|Hoth asteroid field]].
